description: List the banks Enable Banking can reach, by two-letter country code. The name field is what start_auth takes, psuTypes says whether the bank exposes personal accounts, business accounts or both, and maxConsentDays is how long that bank will let a consent last. Pass an empty country for every bank in every market. Served from a one-hour cache.

country.description: Two-letter code, like RO. Empty means every market, a large answer.
